description: Truck and container traffic through the Aqaba ports is a series of data sets listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Aqaba Company for Ports operations and Management. Statistics of arriving and departing trucks by nationality in brief. Coverage: Jordan. The portal lists 4 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Aqaba Company for Ports operations and Management. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Jordonian License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
